tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enforced on all builds, development builds included; there is no dev-build exception that disables it for local testing. This is consistent with the project's separate decision to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception for any service.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement. It says TLS certificate verification is enforced on all builds, development builds included, with no dev-build exception.

The wording comes from the project's recorded decision #31 ("Verification on all builds is the right call, even in development environments"). It also mentions decision #34, which enforces HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exception for any service. I left out the earlier plan to disable verification in dev builds, since #31 replaced it.

The first attempt to create the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file-write tool instead. The tool reported success. I didn't read the file back afterwards.

Muninn's startup check also flagged that 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate; `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` has the details.
